crown-1998.title: Crown 1998
crown-1998.description: A masterclass in automotive engineering, combining classic luxury aesthetics with robust performance architecture.
crown-1998.reviewText: The Toyota Crown 1998 represents an era where absolute comfort met bulletproof reliability. Outfitted with a sophisticated 6-speed automatic transmission and a robust engine churning out 220 horsepower, it delivers a uniquely planted, smooth ride quality...
